authority: PI, 2026-09-01: 'Phase 0: prove prefix replay works. Before designing anything else.'

THE_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.statement: (seed, action prefix) -> s_t is a FUNCTION. Replaying the same action prefix from the same seed in a FRESH environment reproduces the same state.
THE_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.why_it_is_load_bearing: There is no state save/restore anywhere in gpu_env -- no snapshot, no deepcopy hook, no restore. Prefix replay is the only route to matched causal branching that adds no environment surface. If this claim is false, every Q estimate in Phase 1 compares continuations from states that were never actually the same state, and the entire program is built on sand.
THE_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.what_this_does_NOT_test: Policy determinism. The replay feeds RECORDED actions rather than re-querying the policy, which is exactly right: Phase 1 will supply actions from four different policies, so what must be deterministic is the ENVIRONMENT given a seed and an action sequence.

HARD_GATE.if_it_fails: Phase 1 does not start. The program returns to the PI for a decision about adding state save/restore to the environment. It is not worked around.
HARD_GATE.this_is_a_capability_test_not_an_experim: It consumes no EVAL block and produces no payoff claim.

COMPARISON.fields: EVERY key present in the observation dict, plus the global state, plus reward and done. Not a chosen subset -- selecting convenient fields is how a determinism test passes without being true.
COMPARISON.PRIMARY_CRITERION: EXACT bitwise equality (numpy array_equal) at every compared prefix point.

TOLERANCE_POLICY.rule: NO numerical tolerance is adopted in this run. The primary criterion is exact equality.
TOLERANCE_POLICY.why: A tolerance chosen after seeing the deviations is threshold-shopping in the same family as the moves this project has refused throughout. This run reports magnitudes; it does not absorb them.
TOLERANCE_POLICY.if_mismatches_occur: the verdict is FAILED or PARTIAL, and the record reports the first divergent step, the field, and max |diff|. Adopting a frozen tolerance afterwards requires a separate PI decision with those magnitudes on the table.

TEST_MATRIX.seeds: 11500001..11500008, n=8, in this program's fresh 115xxxxx namespace, disjoint from every block the ladder used

prefix_points.near_terminal: T-1, the last state before the episode ends
prefix_points.reset: k=0, an added precondition check: two fresh envs on the same seed must agree before any action is taken
prefix_points.why_these: PI: 'short/mid/late prefixes ... and near-terminal states.' Divergence that only appears late is the failure mode that would silently corrupt Phase 1's most interesting states.

event_states.rule: If the step info exposes such events, every step where one fires is added as an additional prefix point. If it does NOT expose them, that fact is RECORDED AS A STATED LIMITATION of this Phase 0 result -- it is never silently skipped, and the resulting verdict carries the limitation explicitly.
event_states.why: absence is an error state, not a pass

TEST_MATRIX.replay_environment: a FRESH env instance per replay, built from the same seed with the same pole setup. Continuing the original object would test nothing.

NEGATIVE_CONTROL.design: replay a DELIBERATELY PERTURBED action prefix (one action replaced by a different but genuinely recorded action) and require the resulting state to DIFFER from the recorded state.
NEGATIVE_CONTROL.why_a_recorded_action: substituting a different RECORDED action keeps the perturbation inside the valid action space, so the control cannot succeed merely by feeding the environment something out of range.
NEGATIVE_CONTROL.must_fail: If the perturbed replay also matches, the comparison is not measuring what it claims -- it would be comparing something to itself, or the compared fields would be insensitive to actions. In that case the whole Phase 0 result is void regardless of how the primary checks came out.
NEGATIVE_CONTROL.why_this_is_required: A guard that cannot fail proves nothing. Every smoke in this project carries one, and the V4 critic-routing smoke caught its own equivalent by deliberately misrouting.

PREREGISTERED_VERDICTS.REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE_CONFIRMED: exact bitwise equality at EVERY prefix point on every seed and both poles, AND the negative control detected the perturbation
PREREGISTERED_VERDICTS.REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE_PARTIAL: exact equality holds at some prefix points and fails at others -- typically early-yes, late-no, which indicates accumulating divergence
PREREGISTERED_VERDICTS.REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE_FAILED: mismatches broadly, or at any near-terminal point, or the negative control did not detect the perturbation (in which case the run is void, not merely failed)

WHAT_THIS_MAY_NOT_DO: adopt a numerical tolerance to convert a mismatch into a pass
narrow the compared fields after seeing which one diverges
drop a seed, pole or prefix point after seeing its result
proceed to Phase 1 on a PARTIAL or FAILED verdict without a separate PI decision
